data.review_body:
If I could give zero stars I would!!! Let us begin with clothing. What you receive is hardly what is displayed on their site. The fabric is inferior. The flow of the garment is misleading. The fit is often off, particularly with regards to length. They are either entirely too short and or is not as full or flowing as is depicted in the photo. 
Other items such as jewelry. Earrings are much smaller than shown in pictures. So misleading. Art… much smaller and shorter than what is photographed. I purchased images which were displayed behind a sofa seemingly filled the wall just as you would have it. They appeared to be 24 maybe 30 inches in the picture. Upon arrival they were 10 to 12 inches. If you place them behind the sofa on the wall, you would never see them!!!
Your order seldom arrive together returning them is a nightmare. Their Bogus credit plan where you earn points to be applied to your purchase. Makes no sense at all. I ordered from them 02 years ago so disappointed. After two years I stumbled upon the site again saw a couple items that were appealing and just as it was two years ago, junk!!! I would dare say save your money. Shame on Temu and shame on the powers that be that allow them to get away with this. Misrepresentation of products, keeping inferior fabrics products, and not resembling photos.
data.review_headline: If I could give zero stars I would!!

data.review_body:
I have been a  very good customer of Temu, never had a problem that wasn’t sorted straight away. However my last experience has left a sour taste.
I ordered a ladies Jacket size 16 and some pegs to make up minimum order. Jacket arrived  a very small parcel. Very badly creased and sleeves were very wide and long.
Asked for return. Was offered 84p + £11, as I thought, credit. Turned out it was a coupon and only 3 days shelf life! I made my order up to £15, and kept getting message, had to add more for free delivery over £15. Ended up £26 and I decided, I wasn’t happy about the situation at all. So I have  cancelled the whole order. 
Normally you would get a credit, never heard of Coupon which expires in 3 days.
So Temu, I shall give the jacket to Charity and I have lost my just on £12. But you have lost a ver valued customer, 
I am extremely disappointed with the situation . 

Update, Temu sent message on  Trustpilot after my review. Said they would look into it. Advised me to contact Customer Service Bot. Did this got no joy. Was supposed then to pass me on to agent. After trying to explain through messages the problem I was told to give order number. It meant coming off the chat and getting the Order number. Told them this. After 30 minutes I’ve given up. My time is not being wasted on Temu any more. Terrible company when things go wrong.

Still waiting for Temu to contact me. Have sent order number, email etc. They are all talk. Nobody has contacted me. Just beware of their stupid offers. They don’t exist. Extremely dissatisfied by Temu. Be warned!

data.review_body:
I have given this a 2 star review because I have not been unhappy with Temu's service until recently. I was dubious initially about shopping from Temu as had heard that they sell customers data to 3rd parties, still not had evidence of this in the 2 years I have been shopping with them, but my recent experience has now made me decide not to continue giving them my custom.  A package I ordered was delivered to someone elses property by the courier. I asked for a refund, but was denied it twice. Temu and the seller consistently said the package had been delivered. This disagreement between us has now lasted over a week and in that time, I have pointed out to Temu and the seller that the pinpointed GPS location from the couriers scanner does not match the location of my property. I have yet to see if they accept this as they have refused to accept all previous denials that the package has been delivered to my property. So I will not give Temu my custom again. 
And this is what I have just read on another customers review - if your items do not arrive, arrive damaged, or do not match the description or photos, you will be offered a full refund under Temu's Purchase Protection program - they have twice refused to refund me for an undelivered parcel but expect me to go round to neighbours houses asking if they have it.
